title: Pre-Market Briefing - 2026-10-15
markdown:
## 1. Market Tone
- **Confirmed:** Pre-market tone is mixed-to-lower. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News* reported **S&P 500** at 7,752 (-0.2%), **Nasdaq-100** at 29,861 (-0.9%), **Dow** at 52,069 (+0.4%), and **Bitcoin** at $81,157 (-2.6%).
- **Confirmed:** AI-related and chip names were under pressure. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News* said global chip stocks sold off as investors questioned whether the AI rally had overextended.
- **Confirmed:** **Nvidia**, **Broadcom**, and **Intel** all closed more than 3% lower Wednesday and were down at least 1% before Thursday’s open. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** **CoreWeave** fell 15% Wednesday after its 2032 bond yield touched 15%. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Interpretation:** The early tone favors defensive caution around high-multiple AI and semiconductor names, while broad index direction is uneven rather than uniformly risk-off. Source basis: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.

## 2. Macro And Calendar
- **Confirmed:** No major macro data releases or central-bank events were listed in the provided email sources for the pre-market window. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** The main calendar item highlighted was earnings. **Prologis** reports before the opening bell, and **Interactive Brokers** reports after the close today. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** For **Prologis**, the email noted it has met or beaten EPS estimates in each of the past four quarters, and that any full-year guidance update matters most. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** For **Interactive Brokers**, analysts expect 67 cents per share, roughly 17.5% growth year over year, with September trading activity already up 6% year over year. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Interpretation:** The session’s most actionable scheduled catalysts in the provided sources are earnings and guidance, especially anything that can move REIT and brokerage sentiment before and after the cash open. Source basis: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.

## 3. Earnings And Company News
- **Confirmed:** **TSM** posted a sixth straight quarter of record profit. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** **Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing** reported third-quarter revenue above guidance and net income up 69% to a record NT$763.1 billion, about $23.9 billion. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** **TSM** operating margin was 58.7%, above its 58% guidance range, while gross margin dipped slightly during its 2-nanometer ramp. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** High-performance computing accounted for 68% of **TSM** revenue. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** **TSM** plans to invest $265 billion in Arizona and is reportedly weighing Texas as well. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Interpretation:** **TSM** is the cleanest positive catalyst in the source set: strong earnings, strong margins, and continued U.S. capacity build-out. Source basis: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** **RKLB** fell 10% in pre-market trading after saying **Neutron**’s first flight has slipped to 2027. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** The email said Rocket Lab had previously aimed for Neutron to reach the launch pad in Q4, and it plans to charge about $55 million per Neutron flight versus around $8.5 million per Electron flight. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Interpretation:** The delay pushes expected higher-value Neutron revenue further out and keeps execution risk front and center for **RKLB** into the open. Source basis: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** **Prologis** reports before the open; the email said management’s full-year guidance and any comment on the SEGRO takeover matter most. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** **Interactive Brokers** reports after the close; the email highlighted expected EPS of 67 cents, September trading activity up 6% year over year, and focus on net interest income and margin lending. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Confirmed:** Broad weakness hit several AI-related names, including **Nvidia**, **Broadcom**, **Intel**, and **CoreWeave**. Source: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
- **Interpretation:** The company-news backdrop is split: earnings strength from **TSM** versus sentiment pressure and execution delays for **RKLB**, with AI-chip weakness still likely to color early trading. Source basis: *The Motley Fool, Breakfast News*.
